title: TRICARE Select Monthly Share Schedule for TRICARE Prime First Installments
content:
**Schedule.** For the first installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment, Select's monthly share is read from the beneficiary's TRICARE Select installment charge whose coverage period begins latest:

- where it is a **monthly** installment, its whole amount;
- where it is a **quarterly** installment, one third of its amount, rounded to the cent;
- **otherwise**, one twelfth of its amount (divided by 12), rounded to the cent.

| Hypothetical latest TRICARE Select installment | Select's monthly share |
|---|---|
| monthly, 30.00 | 30.00 |
| quarterly, 90.00 | 30.00 |
| annual, 365.00 | 30.42 |
